verdict.line: You lose when you eat a 2-stack Ntofo pull or get caught by his W dash-stun; you win every trade where you just out-sustain him with Q.

brief.thesis: K'Sante has no ranged tool — every point of damage he deals comes from melee-range Q (Ntofo Strikes, 450 range) or a committed dash (W/E). Yorick's Q (Last Rites, 6-4s cooldown) heals on every landed hit, so flat auto+Q trading out-sustains him as long as you don't stand still for his second Q stack or his W charge-dash.

theirWindow.what: At 2 stacks Q fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in — step out of 450 range immediately rather than trading through it, since the pull chains into a free combo you didn't ask for.

yourWindow.when: right after his W or E goes on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Path Maker (14-10s CD) and Footwork (10-8s CD) are his only dash/shield tools. The moment either is used for farm or repositioning, walk in and trade Q (Last Rites) plus autos — he has nothing to answer with for several seconds.

powerCurve.note: both melee, short cooldowns, no big commitment yet
Last Rites sustain grinds down his flat Q poke
Maiden pressure, he has no ranged wave clear
All Out (R) burst window if you're caught alone
itemization and split-push tempo decide it

start.why: Blunts his auto-attack and Q poke in a matchup with no ranged damage to punish you for standing in melee — the regen wins extended trades.

boots.why: He has no magic damage; flat reduction on every auto and Ntofo Strikes hit matters more than movement speed here.

core.why: Shred armor to keep out-damaging him in trades and fights once he starts stacking resistances to survive your sustain.
The damage spike that lets your post-dash trade windows actually end fights instead of just chipping him.
Cooldown reduction stacks your already-fast Q (Last Rites) even further, compounding the sustain advantage.

situational.when: you're ahead and want to turn the Maiden push into a lane you can't be contested in
he's hitting level 6+ All Out burst windows and you need to survive the all-in rather than out-trade it
you're fed and want to close out all-ins faster once his shield (Footwork) is down

runes.keystoneWhy: Triggers on your first hit of a trade and heals you, directly amplifying the Last Rites sustain pattern that wins this matchup — Bone Plating in the same tree also blunts his Q+auto poke combo before you commit. Master-tier Yorick players instead run Conqueror (Precision) across 567 games, which suits a more aggressive all-in style for players comfortable fighting through his Path Maker stun rather than sustain-trading around it.

summoners.why: Flash answers his W knockback-stun and R All Out knockback so you're not caught with no outs; Teleport lets you capitalize on the post-6 Maiden split-push advantage since he has no wave clear to contest it. Flash+Ignite (58.8% win rate) is the alternative if you want to force early kills off his short cooldowns instead.

playing.title: Trade the instant his dash is down
playing.detail: Once Footwork (10-8s CD) or Path Maker (14-10s CD) is used for farm or repositioning, he has no shield or dash for several seconds. Walk in with Q and autos immediately.

playing.title: Never stand in range at 2 Ntofo stacks
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes builds a stack on hit; at 2 stacks it fires a shockwave that pulls you in. Back out of his 450 range the moment you see the second stack.

playing.title: Poke with E before he commits
playing.detail: Mourning Mist (700 range, 12-8s CD) outranges everything he has pre-dash. Chip his armor and HP from range before he's forced to engage.

playing.title: Don't Q into his W charge
playing.detail: Path Maker has a charge-up where he takes reduced damage before dashing with knockback and stun. Hold Last Rites until after the dash resolves, not during the channel.

playing.title: Wall his All Out follow-up
playing.detail: His R (All Out, 250 range) knocks back and transforms his kit for bonus damage and healing at the cost of reduced defenses. If he pops it on you, drop W (Dark Procession, 600 range) behind you to block his chase path.

playing.title: Push waves hard after level 6
playing.detail: Maiden raises Walkers from kills and empowers your attacks on her target. He has no ranged wave clear, so shove and force him to either match CS loss or get solo-killed.

playing.title: Spam Q every cooldown in extended fights
playing.detail: Last Rites drops to a 4s cooldown at max rank and heals you on every landed hit. In any fight longer than a few seconds, your sustain compounds past anything his kit answers.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample figures above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability readings, trade timing, and tactical notes are my own analysis applied on top of that data.
